metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Bryce Canyon National Park appear lower compared to Las Vegas during 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: I need to compare nighttime light intensity between Bryce Canyon National Park and Las Vegas in 2024. I'll use NOAA's VIIRS Nighttime Lights data (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V21')), which provides monthly composites of nighttime light radiance. 2. Masking strategy: Nighttime lights data doesn't require cloud masking in the traditional sense (it's already processed). I'll calculate mean radiance for both locations. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Valid Zero (B answer): If Bryce Canyon has lower intensity than Las Vegas (which is expected due to less development). - Valid Non-zero (A answer): If the comparison shows Bryce Canyon is NOT lower (unlikely but possible). - C1: If no VIIRS data exists for 2024 in the collection. - C2: If pixels are masked/invalid after processing. - C3: If the result is None or NaN. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometries const brycCanyon = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.1871, 37.5790]); // Bryce Canyon center const lasVegas = ee.Geometry.Point([-115.1372, 36.1699]); // Las Vegas center // Buffer to create regions (10km radius) const brycBuffer = brycCanyon.buffer(10000); const vegasBuffer = lasVegas.buffer(10000); // Load VIIRS Nighttime Lights data for 2024 const startDate = '2024-01-01'; const endDate = '2024-12-31'; const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V21') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('avg_rad'); // Average radiance band // Check if collection is empty const collectionSize = viirs.size().getInfo(); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No VIIRS data available for 2024.'); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`VIIRS 2024 Images: ${collectionSize}`); // Create annual composites (mean of all monthly data) const viirs2024 = viirs.mean(); // Calculate mean nighttime radiance for both locations const brycStats = viirs2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: brycBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const vegasStats = viirs2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: vegasBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Get pixel counts to validate data const brycCount = viirs2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: brycBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const vegasCount = viirs2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: vegasBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const brycRadiance = brycStats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const vegasRadiance = vegasStats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const brycPixels = brycCount.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const vegasPixels = vegasCount.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // Validate data if (brycPixels === 0 || vegasPixels === 0) { console.log(`Valid pixels - Bryce: ${brycPixels}, Vegas: ${vegasPixels}`); console.log('C2'); return; } if (brycRadiance === null || vegasRadiance === null || isNaN(brycRadiance) || isNaN(vegasRadiance)) { console.log('Calculation resulted in null or NaN values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Output statistics console.log(`Bryce Canyon 2024 Radiance: ${brycRadiance.toFixed(4)} (Pixels: ${brycPixels})`); console.log(`Las Vegas 2024 Radiance: ${vegasRadiance.toFixed(4)} (Pixels: ${vegasPixels})`); // Determine if Bryce Canyon is lower than Las Vegas const brycLower = brycRadiance < vegasRadiance; if (brycLower) { console.log('Bryce Canyon nighttime intensity IS lower than Las Vegas.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Bryce Canyon nighttime intensity is NOT lower than Las Vegas.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
